title: Amazing Space Facts
description: Educational landscape video about space facts. Uses documentary preset with cool grade, calm music, and high-contrast captions. Perfect for YouTube or educational content.
script:
Did you know the sun is 93 million miles from Earth? [Visual: sun solar flare corona] [Transition: fade] [Grade: warm]
Light takes eight minutes to reach us from the sun. [Visual: earth from space blue] [Transition: slide] [Grade: cool]
A teaspoon of neutron star weighs six billion tons. [Visual: neutron star pulsar] [Transition: fade] [Kinetic: on]
There are more stars than grains of sand on Earth. [Visual: milky way galaxy stars] [Transition: slide] [Grade: cool]
The largest known star is 1,700 times bigger than our sun. [Visual: red supergiant star] [Transition: fade] [Grade: cinematic]
Space is completely silent — there's no atmosphere for sound. [Visual: astronaut space silence] [Transition: fade]
Every atom in your body came from a star explosion. [Visual: supernova explosion cosmic] [Transition: zoomblur] [Grade: cinematic]
